items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: He'd play piano for us... So we'd practice. We'd practice all evening, all night.

ctx.x: No, it was Eugene Love, not Clarence. And he would come over and he'd have patience, and we'd keep on until we played this first bar right. Let's go over it again until we got it, you know, one of those things. Just took an interest in the group. He'd play piano for us...
Oh, that was very helpful at that stage.
